fact.label: Vehicle warranty
fact.scope: CUPRA Australia brand terms inherited by the three named MY26 Tavascan versions
qualifications: Starts at original retail delivery for a new vehicle; first CUPRA Agent registration for a demonstrator.
Vehicles sold and used in Australia; proper use, prescribed maintenance and stated manufacturing-defect exclusions apply. No fresh warranty restart for a demonstrator.

gradeReview.reason: Current Australian manufacturer brand terms apply to the explicitly listed new BEV versions with their actual start, use and claim conditions.

fact.label: Battery warranty
fact.value: 8 years / 160,000 km, whichever first; below 70% initial usable capacity trigger
fact.scope: CUPRA Australia brand terms inherited by the three named MY26 Tavascan versions
qualifications: BEV battery terms: authorised Agent measurement; capacity claim triggers below 70% of initial net usable capacity.
Remedy restores at least 78% at 3 years / 60,000 km, 74% at 5 years / 100,000 km, and 70% at 8 years / 160,000 km. These are restoration floors, not earlier failure triggers.

Original delivery/first-Agent-registration start; proper charging/care/maintenance apply. New or reconditioned components may be used. Accident-related damage, unapproved changes and permanently removed batteries are excluded. PHEV capacity exclusion is not applied.

gradeReview.reason: Current Australian manufacturer brand terms apply to the explicitly listed new BEV versions with their actual start, use and claim conditions.

fact.label: Roadside assistance
fact.scope: CUPRA Australia brand terms inherited by the three named MY26 Tavascan versions
qualifications: Runs from vehicle-warranty start; a demonstrator does not receive a reset term.
CUPRA Assist conditions include eligible registration, roadworthiness, required maintenance, geographic coverage and benefit limits. Not an unlimited-service promise.

Physical stock, exact new-versus-demonstrator condition, factory allocation and individual delivery timing are unverified.

Safety recall context: Australian Government REC-006687 / CUPRA campaign 94S9 covers 318 VIN-identified Tavascan vehicles from 2024–2026. Affected drivers should not use advanced full beam assist until rectified; the remedy is a free dealer software update. Check the actual vehicle VIN with CUPRA against the recall. No candidate vehicle is assumed affected or remedied, and this is not a whole-range stop-driving notice.
